final: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.location, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS average_ratio FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_id, e.location), ranked AS (SELECT event_id, location, average_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY average_ratio DESC NULLS LAST) AS event_rank FROM event_averages) SELECT event_id, location, average_ratio, event_rank FROM ranked WHERE event_rank <= 3 ORDER BY location, event_rank, event_id
